notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
[h3][b]Dear Idols,[/b][/h3]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback on [b]Idol Party[/b]. We are committed to improving the game and providing a better experience for everyone. We are excited to announce some upcoming updates:

[h3][b]This Week's Update[/b][/h3]

[b]Adding More High-Difficulty Songs[/b]: We know many players are looking for more challenges, so this week we will add several new high-difficulty songs to bring more fun and excitement to your gameplay.
[b]Adding 5x, 6x, 7x, and 8x Speed Options[/b]: To cater to different player preferences, we will introduce multiple speed options, allowing you to choose the speed that suits your play style.

[h3][b]Next Week's Update Plan[/b][/h3]

[b]Custom Key Bindings[/b]: We will launch a key binding modification feature in the game, allowing players to customize controls according to their habits for a more convenient experience.
[b]Fixing Various Issues Preventing Game Access[/b]: We have identified and fixed several issues that were preventing some players from accessing the game. These fixes will be included in next week's update.

[h3][b]Future Update Plans[/b][/h3]

[b]Fixing Issues with Viewing Mails[/b]: We will address the issue where some players cannot see mail content, ensuring that important information is not missed.
[b]Fixing Clothing Issues[/b]: We have noticed that some clothing items cause characters to lose their upper bodies, and this will be fixed in a future update.
[b]Adding Push and Pull Camera Functions for Screenshot Angles[/b]: We will add push and pull camera buttons to help players better adjust screenshot angles.
[b]Adding Borderless Window Mode[/b]: Multi-monitor users will be able to switch between screens more conveniently with the addition of a borderless window mode.
[b]Fixing Traditional Mode Background Camera Issues[/b]: In traditional mode, turning off the background camera leads to chaotic switching. We have confirmed this issue and will fix it soon.
[b]Adding Restart Button in Single-Player Mode[/b]: We will add a restart button in single-player mode, allowing players to restart the game midway through.
We hope these updates will enhance your gaming experience. If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions, please leave a comment below. We are continuously working on improvements!

Thank you once again for your support and feedback. Let's look forward to these exciting improvements together!

Best regards,
The Idol Party Development Team

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
[h3][b]Dear Idols,[/b][/h3]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback on [b]Idol Party[/b]. We are committed to improving the game and providing a better experience for everyone. We are excited to announce some upcoming updates:

[h3][b]This Week's Update[/b][/h3]

[b]Adding More High-Difficulty Songs[/b]: We know many players are looking for more challenges, so this week we will add several new high-difficulty songs to bring more fun and excitement to your gameplay.
[b]Adding 5x, 6x, 7x, and 8x Speed Options[/b]: To cater to different player preferences, we will introduce multiple speed options, allowing you to choose the speed that suits your play style.

[h3][b]Next Week's Update Plan[/b][/h3]

[b]Custom Key Bindings[/b]: We will launch a key binding modification feature in the game, allowing players to customize controls according to their habits for a more convenient experience.
[b]Fixing Various Issues Preventing Game Access[/b]: We have identified and fixed several issues that were preventing some players from accessing the game. These fixes will be included in next week's update.

[h3][b]Future Update Plans[/b][/h3]

[b]Fixing Issues with Viewing Mails[/b]: We will address the issue where some players cannot see mail content, ensuring that important information is not missed.
[b]Fixing Clothing Issues[/b]: We have noticed that some clothing items cause characters to lose their upper bodies, and this will be fixed in a future update.
[b]Adding Push and Pull Camera Functions for Screenshot Angles[/b]: We will add push and pull camera buttons to help players better adjust screenshot angles.
[b]Adding Borderless Window Mode[/b]: Multi-monitor users will be able to switch between screens more conveniently with the addition of a borderless window mode.
[b]Fixing Traditional Mode Background Camera Issues[/b]: In traditional mode, turning off the background camera leads to chaotic switching. We have confirmed this issue and will fix it soon.
[b]Adding Restart Button in Single-Player Mode[/b]: We will add a restart button in single-player mode, allowing players to restart the game midway through.
We hope these updates will enhance your gaming experience. If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions, please leave a comment below. We are continuously working on improvements!

Thank you once again for your support and feedback. Let's look forward to these exciting improvements together!

Best regards,
The Idol Party Development Team
